integrity: Standalone standard-library checker enumerates all polyhedral cells, incidence links and coherent orientations, alongside a finite mathematical argument. No independent mathematical or bibliographic validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the ordinary polyhedral Hom(C5,H) with H the five-regular folded five-cube; not the ten-regular complement, not all folded cubes or all graph-Hom complexes. The top-homology symmetry character is established, but not the complete first-homology representation.
title: The pentagon Hom complex of the five-regular Clebsch graph is an orientable surface of genus \(241\)
